notes.title: Pyrocynical Collab – Claim Your Epic Summons!
notes.content:
🔥 Pyrocynical Has Landed in Eden Survivors!

We’ve teamed up with Pyrocynical for a special limited-time collaboration across all versions of the game.

Here’s what you get:


A custom in-game offer designed by Pyrocynical, available right after you complete Chapter 1
A redeem code: PYRO2025
Rewards: 10 x Epic Summoning Pods, completely free
    

To claim your code:


Complete Chapter 1
Go to Settings > Redeem
Enter PYRO2025


This offer is only available for a short time, so don’t miss it!

notes.title: What’s New in Eden Survivors – Update Recap!
notes.content:
Hey Commanders,

We’ve been working hard since launch—and it’s time to show off what’s new in Eden Survivors!

🧠 Major Improvements:


Polished tutorial and smoother early-game flow
Bug fixes & performance boosts across many devices
Better in-game pause menu
Better information on drops inside the shop under the pods Info button. 


🌑 Coming Soon – Lunar Explore Event:


Earn Sonar Tickets by playing
Uncover rewards on a 5x5 grid
Finish 3 lines to clear the board & earn big prizes
Discover Golden Asteroids to unlock the Golden Lunar Fest
Trade Lunar Crystals in the new event shop
Event duration: 7 days + 2-day exchange grace period


🎉 Coming Soon - Pyrocynical Collab:

More info will be revealed soon on discord!


🚀 Now’s the perfect time to return or start fresh.
Join our community on Discord for more surprises and tips!

notes.title: Easter Carnival – 7-Day Login Gem Event!
notes.content:
Hey Commander,
The Easter Carnival is here and Eden is feeling festive! 🐣🌸
We’re celebrating with a 7-day login event packed full of gem rewards to boost your power, unlock new girls, and dominate the battlefield.

🎁 How it works:

 - Log in once a day during the event.
 - Each day brings a new gem reward.
 
Don’t miss out — this event is only available for a limited time.
Hop in, claim your gems, and keep Eden safe this spring!

See you in the bar,
– The Eden Survivors Team
